rtl_context: ChipTop, simulated off-chip TL memory and SPI card

sba-mailbox.load: simulated TAP/DMI SBA word writes and readback; no preloading

independent_probe.configuration: volatile JTAG; all three SLRs DONE=1 and CRC_ERROR=0
independent_probe.test_scope: independent electrical UART/configuration fixture; no Rocket, DDR, SD or Linux

buffered_soc.scope: Volatile, isolated J106 configuration + J4 UART. No external soft TAP, SD or other FMC traffic; not a qualification of all I/O, CDC or 2 GiB of memory.

linux_runtime.scope: one Linux process touching an allocated 16 MiB buffer, not a peak memory bandwidth or full capacity test

split_halt_soc.configuration: Buffered five-stage Rocket, 100 MHz; halt inputs registered separately before OR; UART5. J106/J4 volatile bring-up only.

linux_profile.scope: one Linux process touching an allocated 16 MiB buffer, not a peak memory bandwidth or full capacity test

first_attempt.first_rejection: wrong echo, digest or acknowledgement at record 27
first_attempt.scope: Diagnosis only. A reconstructed echo never substitutes for strict byte/digest acceptance; does not identify the hardware or software cause.

second_attempt.scope: single Linux console; includes input, terminal echo and output; not an RX-only IRQ count or peak link rate

integrated_packed_linux.dot4: No platform device on this baseline; not a driver pass.

coremark.scope: One physical VCU118, one RV64GC hart, under Linux; independent measurement, not certified.

coremark_same_boot_repeats.scope: Three distinct invocations on the same live Linux shell and same ELF, not independent board boots. First invocation also shown in coremark.

uart5.rtl_truncated_timeout: stock UART5 simulator case complete: UART5_STOP TIMEOUT, DPC=0x1003c at 200487692 cycles. Original matrix wrapper returned nonzero due to trailing CR in its exit argument; not a clean whole-suite exit.
uart5.linux_over_serial: verified on VCU118: buffer5i, full baseline firmware, see physical.buffered_soc.tests.linux

dot4.integrated_fpga_timing: Legacy buffered candidate: routed but DRC rejected; no bitstream.

buffered_uart_benchmark_rtl.scope: Rocket ChipTop with modeled external RAM/card
buffered_uart_benchmark_rtl.interpretation: v1 per-vector MMIO, including command/status/fences, took longer than this scalar implementation in this model. No physical speedup claim.

linux_chiptop_debug.load: preload simulated TL RAM; set PC/arguments via simulated JTAG; no SD or serial payload transfer

stock_route_only.stage: Explore route from original placed checkpoint; no post-route phys_opt, no bitstream

debug_clock_experiment.stock_compared: same exact debug gate input, no gate on debug_clock; elaborated DTS unchanged
debug_clock_experiment.fpga_timing: meets routed constraints; manual crossing / external timing review is separate

linux_diagnostic_128m.mode: debug-linux-console; preload via simulated memory, handoff via simulated JTAG

changes_vs_clock_only: registered depth-2 TileLink A/D queues on the debug slave
explicit three-flop receiver attributes for tile debug interrupt

generated_ad_buffer_unit.stimulus: independent ready/valid patterns, directed full-queue synchronous resets, final drain

integrated_post_synth_irq.disposition: SRL removed, mixed-clock OR still present; no CDC signoff

routed_gray_characterization.scope: Temporary 5 ns bus-skew characterization on an already routed design, not an implemented constraint, CDC waiver, guaranteed MTBF or hardware calibration. Signed vendor skew is not a physical one-way flight time.

halt_source_experiment.change_vs_buffered: split JTCK ordinary halt and debug-clock halt-on-reset; register both for two receiver edges before OR; keep original three tile receiver stages
halt_source_experiment.scope: real generated TLDebugModule, driven via DMI; hart reset status input supplied by fixture, not physical hart reset
halt_source_experiment.integrated_netlist_stage: post-synthesis: remote FF -> meta -> clean; local two FF; both OR inputs destination FFs; tile receiver 3 FDRE and 0 SRLs

reset_wrangler_clock_only_kit.level: generated ResetWrangler RTL with actual debounce register and per-domain reset catchers, not a MIG/PLL or physical reset test

board_io_audit.reference: XilinxBoardStore VCU118 2.4 and UG1224 v1.4 tables 3-2, 3-26, 3-30 and 3-31
board_io_audit.scope: Pad assignments and generated IP configuration only; not active IOB directions, external timing, supply voltage, calibration or board execution.

mig_adapter_rtl.scope: generated board TL-to-AXI chain including async queues; simulated AXI slave substitutes vendor MIG. No PHY or physical DDR.

clock_only_ignored_ddr_endpoints.scope: One max and one min path per ignored endpoint. Not every launch/capture pair, skew, routed slack or a CDC waiver.

sparse_address_diagnostic.physical_kit: buffered and split-halt; independent captures under physical

os_workload.scope: single-hart Linux user processes, shared mapping + atomic, private mapping + fork, live S/D FP state between pipe exchanges; not ISA certification or SMP

qemu_controls.machine: QEMU virt, single hart, read-only ext4 fixture

os_workload.split_halt_vcu118: See physical.split_halt_soc.tests.linux-oscheck for the independent physical run; performed before the fresh serial shell challenge.

optional_packed_boot.scope: Unchanged UART5 ROM and inner firmware. Fixed DDR relocation; CRC32 is an error check, not authentication. See physical results separately.
qemu_virt: OS variant 16 MiB, two-process workload and shell

same_firmware_comparison.scope: first byte queued to verified live shell result; host monotonic observations, excludes JTAG programming
